definitions.window_published: CVE records in PUBLISHED state whose datePublished is within the last 30 days.
definitions.window_passed: Of those, the ones in the Exploited or Likely-next tier at the default evidence bar (50).
definitions.window_by_tier: Window CVEs per tier at the default evidence bar (50).
definitions.published_24h: CVEs published in the last 24 hours.
definitions.passed_24h: Of those, Exploited or Likely next at the default evidence bar.
definitions.published_7d: CVEs published in the last 7 days.
definitions.passed_7d: Of those, Exploited or Likely next at the default evidence bar.
definitions.published_mtd: CVEs published since the start of the current calendar month (UTC).
definitions.published_ytd: CVEs published since January 1 of the current year (UTC).
definitions.rejected_window: REJECTED records dated within the last 30 days (not shown anywhere else).
definitions.kev_total: Entries in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
definitions.kev_adds_30d: KEV entries added in the last 30 days (by dateAdded).
definitions.kev_adds_mtd: KEV entries added since the start of the current calendar month (UTC).
definitions.ai_credited_window: Window CVEs whose CNA credits name an AI system or AI lab (information only).
definitions.batches_window: Batches in the window (patch days and bulk releases): 50+ CVEs from one CNA on one UTC day.
